fields.value: DO NOT DRINK THE WATER WITHOUT BOILING IT FIRST.

anchors.quote: DO NOT DRINK THE WATER WITHOUT BOILING IT FIRST.

fields.value: Bring all water to a boil, let it boil for three (3) minutes, and let it cool before using, or use bottled water

anchors.quote: Bring all water to a boil, let it boil for three (3) minutes, and let it cool before using or use bottled water.

fields.note: the boiling time “three (3) minutes” is scored only here; bottled water is the alternative and does not need boiling

fields.value: drinking, making ice, brushing teeth, washing dishes, and food preparation

anchors.quote: Boiled or bottled water should be used for drinking, making ice, brushing teeth, washing dishes, and food preparation

time.end_condition: the water system informs customers that tests show no bacteria and boiling is no longer needed

anchors.quote: Boiled or bottled water should be used for drinking, making ice, brushing teeth, washing dishes, and food preparation until further notice.
We will inform you when tests show no bacteria and you no longer need to boil your water.

fields.value: If you experience any of these symptoms and they persist, you may want to seek medical advice
applies_if: has symptoms such as diarrhea, cramps, nausea or headaches, and they persist

anchors.quote: Human pathogens in these wastes can cause short-term effects, such as diarrhea, cramps, nausea, headaches, or other symptoms.
If you experience any of these symptoms and they persist, you may want to seek medical advice.

fields.note: a suggestion (“may want to”), not a requirement

fields.value: Share the information with all the other people who drink this water, by posting this notice in a public place or distributing copies by hand or mail

anchors.quote: Please share this information with all the other people who drink this water
You can do this by posting this notice in a public place or distributing copies by hand or mail.

fields.value: We are now conducting a thorough investigation to determine the source of the contamination

anchors.quote: We are now conducting a thorough investigation to determine the source of the contamination.

name of contact, phone number and mailing address are all blank

applies_if: looking for general guidelines on lessening the risk of infection by microbes

anchors.quote: General guidelines on ways to lessen the risk of infection by microbes are available from the EPA Safe Drinking Water Hotline at 1-800-426-4791.
